_comment: Curated knowledge base of providers offering free LLM API access. The bot verifies all URLs daily, cross-references web search results, and flags dead links. signup values: google | email | github | email+phone | email+cc | cc | none | unknown. expiry values: ongoing | trial | limited | unknown. compat.api values: openai-completions (works with any OpenAI-format client) | google-generative-ai | anthropic-messages | cohere | other.

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
providers.limits: Free tier: 5-30 RPM depending on model; ~9,000 requests/day on Flash; 25 RPD on Pro; 1M token context available
providers.expiry_note: Permanent free tier; quotas reduced late 2025 but still free

compat.notes: OpenAI-compatible endpoint available (generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai); also native Google API

providers.notes: Prompts may be used for training outside EU/UK/EEA

providers.name: Groq
providers.limits: Free tier: 30 RPM, 14,400 requests/day. Very high token throughput (~320 tok/s on 70B)
providers.notes: No-training policy

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.limits: Free models: 20 RPM, 50 requests/day (1,000/day after $10 top-up). One key routes across many providers
providers.expiry_note: Free model list changes; availability per-model

compat.notes: OpenAI-compatible; free model IDs use ':free' suffix (e.g. deepseek/deepseek-chat:free)

providers.notes: Single key, failover across many providers

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.limits: Free plan: 10,000 neurons/day (~300,000 neurons/month)

compat.notes: OpenAI-compatible unified endpoint (/compat) plus native Workers AI API

providers.notes: Smaller context windows than most

providers.name: Mistral (La Plateforme)
providers.limits: Experiment free tier: ~1B tokens/month on Codestral; ~1 request/second; requires opt-in to training
providers.expiry_note: Free Experiment tier ongoing, subject to change
providers.notes: Phone verification at signup; free tier requires training opt-in

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.limits: Free tier: ~1M tokens/day, ~30 RPM. Extremely fast inference
providers.notes: No-training policy

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.limits: Free API credits for developers; ~40 RPM; OpenAI-compatible endpoint
providers.expiry_note: Free credits renew; generous for personal use
providers.notes: Phone verification at signup

providers.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
providers.limits: Free routing credits ~$0.10/month; 300 requests/hour cap
providers.expiry_note: Monthly free credit resets; community rate limits

compat.notes: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (/v1) plus native HF API

providers.notes: Routes to multiple backends (Together, Fireworks, Groq, Cerebras, etc.)

providers.name: Cohere
providers.limits: Trial key: ~20 RPM, 1,000 requests/month; non-commercial use

compat.notes: Native Cohere API (not OpenAI-compatible); needs an adapter/proxy for OpenAI-format clients

providers.notes: Best for RAG; no training on trial tier

providers.name: Z.AI (Zhipu GLM)
providers.limits: Free Flash tier: ~1 request/second, ~1,000 requests/day
providers.expiry_note: Free tier ongoing, subject to change
providers.notes: Chinese provider; global z.ai and China bigmodel.cn consoles

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.limits: Free tier: 15 RPM, 150-1,000 requests/day depending on model; Azure OpenAI-compatible endpoint
providers.expiry_note: Free tier ongoing for public GitHub accounts
providers.notes: Rate limits apply to ALL GitHub models, not per model

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.limits: ~10M token trial for new accounts; thereafter extremely low pay-as-you-go pricing
providers.expiry_note: Trial credits; signup offers change frequently
providers.notes: Excellent reasoning models at low cost

providers.name: xAI (Grok)
providers.limits: Free tier for new accounts: ~5M tokens on signup (valid ~30 days); generous rate limits while it lasts
providers.expiry_note: Limited-time signup offer; verify current status
providers.notes: Free credit amounts change; check docs

providers.name: Fireworks AI
providers.limits: $1 free credit for new accounts; some models free tier
providers.notes: Small credit; fine for benchmarking

providers.name: Together AI
providers.limits: Free signup credit (reported $1-$25 depending on period); pay-as-you-go after
providers.expiry_note: Trial credit; amounts vary over time
providers.notes: Reported credit varies by source; verify on signup

providers.name: Baseten
providers.limits: $30 free credit; card required once credit exhausted
providers.notes: Most generous trial; card needed later

providers.name: SambaNova Cloud
providers.limits: $5 free credit; credit card required at signup
providers.notes: Only 405B-class free access, but card required

providers.name: Coze (ByteDance)
providers.limits: Token-based daily quotas, reset daily; no card

compat.notes: Bot/agent platform, not a plain OpenAI-compatible API; limited usability with OpenAI-format clients

providers.notes: Chat-bot platform; API needs its own auth flow

providers.name: Nebius AI Studio
providers.limits: $1 free credit
providers.notes: Small credit

providers.name: AI21 (Jamba)
providers.limits: $10 trial credit
providers.notes: Hybrid SSM-Transformer architecture

providers.name: Moonshot AI (Kimi)
providers.limits: Free tier with limited daily tokens for new accounts (China phone required for full quota)
providers.notes: Kimi K2 series popular for coding

providers.name: MiniMax
providers.limits: Free tier for new accounts with daily token quota
providers.notes: MiniMax M2.7 also served on Groq free tier

providers.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Qwen)
providers.limits: New users get free quota (tokens) for Qwen models; China/Global dashboards differ
providers.notes: Alibaba Cloud account; free quota for new users

providers.name: BazaarLink (free gateway)
providers.limits: Free OpenAI-compatible API key; model access varies
providers.notes: Unofficial gateway - use at your own risk; do NOT send sensitive data

providers.name: LLM7.io
providers.limits: 30 RPM without signup; up to 5M tokens/day with free email token
providers.notes: New provider; verify reliability before heavy use
